Footers — Credit Notes

Credit note footers are customizable text sections that appear at the bottom of your credit notes.

Use footers to communicate important information about the credit, such as refund procedures, terms and conditions, or references to the original transaction.

Managing Footer Templates

You can create multiple footer templates to handle different credit scenarios.

Each template can be tailored for specific situations like product returns, billing adjustments, or discount credits.

Name
Name

The Name field identifies each footer template in your system.

Choose descriptive names that clearly indicate the template's purpose, making it easy to select the right footer when creating credit notes.

Best Practices for Footer Names

Use specific names that describe the credit scenario, such as:

• 'Product Return Policy' for credits related to returned merchandise

• 'Billing Adjustment Terms' for corrections to previous invoices

• 'Volume Discount Credits' for quantity-based refunds

• 'Service Cancellation Refund' for terminated service agreements

Typical Footer Content

Footer templates commonly include:

• Refund procedures and timelines

• How the credit will be applied (against future purchases or as a refund)

• Validity periods for the credit

• References to original invoice numbers

• Contact information for credit-related inquiries
